shared_elements: low-relief carving of animals in profile
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
animal legs and paws/hooves rendered in profile
justification: Both are low-relief carvings that include profile quadrupeds and a horizontal band carrying a row of repeated motifs (rosettes in A, arch-and-figure units in B), but this is a generic correspondence. A shows a naturalistic narrative scene of a horse drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with human figures holding reins and weapons, while B shows schematic, isolated animals (feline-like descending beasts, a bird with outspread arms/wings, snake-like forms) with no human narrative, no vehicle, and no interaction between figures.
